{{Vanilla}}

{{Infobox auto|Brown Mushroom}}

'''Mushrooms''' come in two kinds with different roles in [[cooking]]. The '''red mushroom''', called a toadstool in food names, is an [[ingredient]] whose [[intrinsic]] is {{EffectLink|Poison}}. The '''brown mushroom''' has no intrinsic and is the pack's pickling agent: every pickle and several other preserves need one.

== Obtaining ==

Mushrooms are found and farmed as in vanilla. A brown or red mushroom block can be crafted into 1 mushroom.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/brown_mushroom_from_mushroom_block.json}}</ref>

{{Recipes|Brown Mushroom}}
{{Recipes|Red Mushroom}}

=== Shelf mushroom ===
A '''shelf mushroom''' is a block of ''Minecraft'' 26.3. In Matcha Flavoured it grows on swamp and [[poplar]] trees and drops itself (2 when fully grown). Its only use in the pack is the [[Rabbit Stew|rabbit stew]] recipe.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/worldgen/feature/swamp_oak.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/worldgen/feature/red_poplar.json}}</ref> The language file already names four shelf mushroom foods, "Braised Shelf Mushrooms", "Pickled Shelf Mushrooms", "Shelf Mushroom Kombucha" and "Springy Stroganoff", but no recipe or loot table makes them.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref> The release notes of 1.12.3 for 26.2 also say that shelf mushrooms "can now be found" in swamps, but that release has none.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.3|quote=Swamps made swampier, new tree type, and shelf mushrooms can now be found here.}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Brown mushroom ===
Brown mushrooms are cooked into [[Braised Mushroom|braised mushroom]]s, which make [[Pickled Mushrooms|pickled mushrooms]] and [[stroganoff]] and top [[Mushroom Pizza|mushroom pizza]]. Raw brown mushrooms are the preservative in [[Pickled Carrots|pickled carrots]], [[Pickled Potatoes|pickled potatoes]], [[Sun-dried Tomatoes|sun-dried tomatoes]], [[Pickled Toadstools|pickled toadstools]], [[Golden Pickled Carrots|golden pickled carrots]], [[Pickled Crimson Fungus|pickled crimson fungus]] and [[Pickled Warped Fungus|pickled warped fungus]], and are also used in [[cheese]], [[mead]] and [[Ramen Stock|ramen stock]].

{{Uses|Brown Mushroom}}

=== Red mushroom ===
Red mushrooms are cooked into [[Braised Toadstool|braised toadstool]]s (Poison, {{Value|Braised Toadstool|duration|effect=Poison|format=clock}}), pickled into [[Pickled Toadstools|pickled toadstools]] (a splash potion of Poison II, 1:00) and crafted into [[Toadstool Stroganoff|toadstool stroganoff]] (Poison, {{Value|Toadstool Stroganoff|duration|effect=Poison|format=clock}}). These foods poison the player who eats them; the pickle can be thrown at mobs.

{{Uses|Red Mushroom}}
